# Scanic lazy-loaded modules

Next.js Turbopack leaves Scanic's relative ML dynamic import as a runtime URL.
These files are copied from the installed `scanic@1.6.0` package and exposed
through rewrites in `next.config.mts` so the lazy import resolves in both local
and production builds.

- Source: https://github.com/marquaye/scanic
